text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Head of the Russian Liberal party Vladimir Zhirinovsky congratulates President Saddam Hussein on start of Iraq's oil exports.
- Jordanian Engineers Union delegation heads for Baghdad.
- Arab League Education, Scientific and Cultural Organisation is to implement four education projects in Iraq.
- Iraqi Olympics Committee will organise big celebrations on Friday to mark recovery of its chairman, Uday, eldest son of Saddam.
- Iraq and Libya sign minutes of cooperation in all fields.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- South Korea donates medicine to Iraqi hospitals.
- Italy is trying to obtain U.N. permission to fly to Iraq a donation of 30 tonnes of food and medicine.
